# Tokgöz Lab

> Tokgöz Lab is a research group in the Electronics Engineering department at Sabancı University (Istanbul, Türkiye), led by Principal Investigator Korkut Kaan Tokgöz. The lab develops energy-efficient millimeter-wave and sub-terahertz CMOS integrated circuits, high-frequency wireless communication systems (including 6G), sensors, Edge AI hardware, and IoT systems — connecting transistor-level circuit design, high-frequency measurement, communication theory, and intelligent edge systems.

Korkut Kaan Tokgöz is a faculty member at Sabancı University. He received his Ph.D. in Physical Electronics from Tokyo Institute of Technology (2018), previously worked as a Specially Appointed Assistant Professor at Tokyo Tech and as a Senior Researcher at NEC in Japan, and joined Sabancı University in January 2022. His research spans millimeter-wave and sub-terahertz integrated circuits, energy-efficient 6G wireless systems, sensors, Edge AI, and IoT hardware and software.
